messages:
kiran: Adaptive shard-scaling PR ready for review. Kernel change introduces dynamic shard weights + continuous-batching gate. Need owners for rollout & perf validation in staging. TL;DR: kernel patch + kv eviction tweak + router policy. PR: https://git.internal/r/infer/pulls/4021 :eyes:

marta: @kiran can you attach a short ops playbook for the canary? who should watch the SLO dashboards during rollout?

samir: I'll own perf validation on staging. quick note — CI unit `shard_map_test` flaky on aarch, failed twice locally. I'll open an issue.

lia: I can update dashboards. which metrics do we want? suggest `kernel.latency_p50`, `kernel.latency_p95`, `batch.size`, `kv.evictions/s`, and a shard-imbalance heatmap.

kiran: thanks. samir -> can you run `./scripts/run_shard_perf.sh --stages=staging --iters=30` and post p50/p95? baseline target: p95 < 120ms, otherwise we need to back out the kernel gating.

samir: running now, posting short logs here. first run p50=58ms p95=210ms (cold cache). repeating with `--warmup=3`.

marta: @ops-bot please reserve canary slot tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT for this change (need traffic split and rollback window).

ops-bot: Canary window requested: 10:00-11:00 PT tomorrow. Ticket created: OPS-732. Please ensure migration script and feature-flag are set.

dev-bot: Deploy precheck summary: feature-flag=ready, migration=blocked (DB migration dependency), observability=dash-present. blockers: migration.

kiran: noted. lia, can you add an alert: `kv.evictions/s > 800 for 2m` and a runbook link? also add a heatmap panel for shard imbalance.

lia: alert added, runbook linked: https://internal/wiki/runbooks/adaptive-shard-scaling. heatmap panel added to the staging dashboard.

samir: opened CI issue #4022 for `shard_map_test` flake and linked logs. rerunning perf with `--warmup=3` now; will paste numbers when done.

kiran: I'll look at the test harness after standup. also need a rollback owner during canary — @marta can you own rollback?

marta: I can own rollback. I'll draft a checklist (abort conditions, traffic cut, config revert) and post it here by EOD.

kiran: perfect. quick ask: if you can review the PR today, drop a :thumbsup: on the PR or here so we can merge before the canary. :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

kiran: thanks all — will follow up with CI blamelist and a short migration note. if anyone else wants to watch staging perf tomorrow, ping here.
